title: Review Table 2 aggregate gross-weight placarding condition
normalized_text: A qualified reviewer would determine whether the Table 2 aggregate gross-weight condition in 49 CFR 172.504(c) is met for the actual hazardous-material shipment and whether a placarding exception applies.

citations.notes: The fixture uses the stated 454 kg (1,001 lb) aggregate gross-weight condition only as a screening fact; classification and exceptions require review.

conditions: when applicable classification, weight, and exception facts are established
deadline_expression: Before offering or transporting the shipment, subject to qualified review.
notes: Normalized fixture record only; it does not determine compliance, shipment authorization, or placarding sufficiency.
